bio: GOLDEN (Alex Golden) is a house music producer and DJ based in Aspen, Colorado, who blends multiple genres into dancefloor-focused sets and serves as Music Director for the Aspen Art Museum's Apres events series.
notable_releases: Forthcoming 2024 release on Defected's YESYESYES imprint
notable_collaborations: Has shared bills with Blond:ish, LP Giobbi, CamelPhat, Eli & Fur, Bedouin, Carlita, Nora En Pure, Nic Fanciulli, and James Murphy
burning_man_history: Has performed at Burning Man; per an Aspen Daily News profile, one of her favorite DJ moments came from an impromptu back-to-back set at her own camp on playa (no named camp confirmed)

bio: Doozie is the project of Brazilian DJ/producer Rodrigo Kost, based in Brasilia, with over a decade in Brazilian electronic music and residencies at three of the country's leading clubs. His productions fuse Afro House, tech house, and deep house.

Vintage Culture is the stage name of Lukas Rafael Ruiz Hespanhol, a Brazilian DJ/producer born July 7, 1993 in Mundo Novo, Mato Grosso do Sul. He abandoned law school in Maringa to pursue music production and has become one of Brazil's most prominent house DJs, reaching No. 9 on the DJ Mag Top 100 in 2024 (No. 10 in 2023).
notable_releases: Hollywood EP (2016); remixes of tracks by Sofi Tukker, Martin Garrix, Tiesto, and Bob Sinclar
labels: Spinnin' Records; also runs his own company/label So Track Boa
notable_collaborations: Fancy Inc, Adam K, Chemical Surf
burning_man_history: Played a sunrise set for Robot Heart at Burning Man 2024, billed as the 'Robot Heart Residency'

bio: Catori is a Brooklyn-based artist whose name means "Spirit" in a Native American language; she blends organic deep house with ambient, meditative soundscapes, drawing on classical training in voice and violin plus Latin, rock, and reggae influences.
notable_releases: Debut EP forthcoming on Bespoke Musik
labels: Bespoke Musik; also affiliated with PYNK and La Familia
notable_collaborations: Has performed alongside Acid Pauli, Mira, Goldcap, Nico Stojan, Kora, and Brian Cid
burning_man_history: Regular appearances at Burning Man's Alborz, Bubbles and Bass, and Trifucta camps

bio: DJ Dragonfly is a West Coast DJ and percussionist with two decades behind the decks, known for blending global/tribal rhythms with electronic dance genres; peers have called him "the DJ's DJ."
burning_man_history: Recorded a live set, "Midnite Mirage," at Sound Garden during Burning Man 2025; broader festival circuit includes Lightning in a Bottle, Symbiosis, Shambhala, Envision, and Earthdance

bio: Greg Eversoul is a DJ/producer with 30+ years behind the decks, starting his career in 1993 at Denver's Rock Island alongside DJ Hipp-e. He cultivated his tech-driven house sound through San Francisco residencies at 1015 Folsom, The End Up, and Ruby Skye, and has played across 9 countries.
labels: Signed to Nervous Records; launched his own label SUPERTAPE Recordings in August 2025
notable_collaborations: DJ Hipp-e; has shared bills with Laurent Garnier and John Digweed (2015 guest mix on Digweed's Transitions)

bio: The Kimonos are a DJ duo -- Gabriel Falanga (from Italy) and Omri Malka (from Tel Aviv) -- who formed in Los Angeles in 2018, blending Afro house, melodic house, and ethnic tones. They became one of the most in-demand duos on the West Coast, playing New York, Miami, LA, Tulum, and Ibiza, and hold residencies at Zenyara Estate (Palm Springs) and Deep Space (Los Angeles).
notable_releases: "En Su Lugar" (2019 single, 20M+ streams); "Ready When You Are" EP; "Blu Oasis"
burning_man_history: Have played Burning Man, alongside Coachella and Heart Festival Miami (per press bios); no specific camp or year confirmed

bio: Docta Reebs is a West Coast (San Francisco Bay Area) DJ specializing in dark, underground techno and house, active with the Zero Fucks crew/collective.
burning_man_history: Affiliated with Zero Fucks (Camp ZF), a Bay Area DJ collective known for its 'Burnhain' shipping-container rave that camps at Burning Man

bio: DJ Spacecamp (also known as Dan White / Corey Reeves) is a San Francisco-based deep/tech house DJ performing professionally since 2006; his name comes from being a five-time graduate of the Advanced Space Academy program in Huntsville, Alabama. He co-founded the DJ collective Zero Fucks and is an editor at DJ Techtools.
notable_collaborations: Has shared stages with The Glitch Mob, Free the Robots, The Hood Internet, Dusky, and Pumpkin
burning_man_history: Has played art cars at Burning Man and co-founded the Zero Fucks Burning Man camp (Camp ZF)

bio: turtletheory is a San Francisco-based electronic producer/DJ (self-described as "just a guy from California who produces electronic music") associated with the Bay Area's Zero Fucks collective, working across dubstep, electro house, progressive house, techno, and trance.
burning_man_history: Has performed at Burning Man, including a 2018 set and a 2019 sunset set at Playarama Bar

bio: Asli Kose is a Turkish DJ/producer classically trained on cello who first gained recognition as an instrumentalist and singer-songwriter in the electro-pop band Bon Mod (one album, one EP, 100+ concerts in Turkey and abroad). She has DJed solo internationally since 2012, and since 2018 has produced a live act, Alem-i Adastra, built around dramatic, melodic themes.
notable_releases: "Diamond Gaze" single (Wold Records), followed by an EP featuring remixes from 8 artists including Deniz Kabu, Gadi Mitrania, and Wolfson
notable_collaborations: Remixers Deniz Kabu, Gadi Mitrania, and Wolfson (on her remix EP)

bio: Xinobi is a Lisbon, Portugal-based musician/DJ/producer (and former amateur skateboarder) working across deep house, melodic house & techno, and Afro house.
notable_releases: "The Source" with Losha & Kevin Adams (Extended Mix, July 2026; Radio edit, June 2026), which charted on Beatport's Melodic House & Techno Hype chart; albums "Beyond The Maps," "Far Away Place," and "On The Quiet"
notable_collaborations: Losha, Kevin Adams, Adana Twins, Misha, Vaarwell, Aram, SKALA, and DJEFF

bio: Tycho is the ambient/downtempo project of San Francisco visual artist and musician Scott Hansen (also known for his ISO50 design studio), a Grammy-nominated act that evolved from a solo studio project into a full touring live band.
notable_releases: Awake (2014, Ghostly International) -- his highest-charting US album (No. 23 Billboard 200, No. 2 Dance/Electronic Albums); Awake Versions remix album (2016)
notable_collaborations: Remixers Com Truise, Christopher Willits, and RJD2 on Awake Versions; Skrillex guested on guitar during his 2015 Robot Heart set
burning_man_history: Performed a live-band set for Robot Heart at Burning Man 2015 (with a Skrillex guitar guest appearance); has also played sunrise DJ sets at Burning Man in other years
